name: Sheet-Pan Andouille Sausage with Brussels Sprouts and Sweet Potato
ingredients_verbatim: 12 ounces andouille sausage, cut into 1-inch chunks
1 medium-sized sweet potato, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1 large yellow onion, cut into 8 wedges
Salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
why: Sausage-forward sheet-pan bake whose PUBLISHED nutrition sits mid-band: 494 cal, 25 g carbs (<=35), 22 g protein per serving. Smoked-sausage-and-vegetable roast, weigh-and-divide friendly and scalable to 14 across multiple pans. Not a dup of the existing bratwurst/kielbasa sheet pans (those use peppers+potatoes or meatballs+kale); this is andouille + Brussels sprouts + a single sweet potato for the only starch, keeping carbs low. Board covers Brussels sprouts, sweet potato and onion; andouille has no board home (nearest is smoked-turkey-sausage / kielbasa) and is flagged for the pricer lane. Confidence high: nutrition read directly from the recipe card.
